text:
Priya (Finance): quick check-in after the postmortem 1: we need a clear owner timeline for the token-count overreporting incident (delayed usage batches). agreed buckets: engineering repro + guardrails, billing corrections, customer comms/support handling. pls confirm owners & dates.

Raj (Eng): i'll own the engineering side. initial hypothesis is a race in the ingest pipeline where delayed logs were double-counted during a replay window. i'll produce a reproducible script and a patch to dedupe on ingestion. ETA: repro + patch by 2026-03-15 18:00 UTC. will also add a unit test that simulates replay with out-of-order events.

Nina (Billing): i'll take corrections. process i propose: 1) get list of impacted request_ids from eng, 2) map to invoices, 3) draft credit memos and mark corrections in staging, 4) run a batched correction on Mon with validation. target to complete batches by 2026-03-22. need eng's CSV to start.

Alex (Support): Support will triage incoming customer tickets and prioritize enterprise customers. i'll prepare a canned response and an escalation path. also request a list of affected customers so we can preemptively reach out.

Priya (Finance): Raj can you paste the query or quick script to extract suspect request_ids? billing needs it asap.

Raj (Eng): here's a lightweight query to find anomalies (not perfect but a start):

```
-- find requests where reported_tokens > generated_tokens by threshold
SELECT r.request_id, r.customer_id, r.reported_tokens, s.estimated_generated
FROM reported_tokens r
LEFT JOIN synth_estimates s USING (request_id)
WHERE r.event_date = '2026-03-14' AND r.reported_tokens - s.estimated_generated > 30
ORDER BY (r.reported_tokens - s.estimated_generated) DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```

Raj (Eng): i'll upload the CSV to s3://billing-incidents/2321112222/affected_requests.csv and ping here when done.

BillingBot: file_upload: s3://billing-incidents/2321112222/affected_requests.csv uploaded by @raj-eng at 2026-03-15T09:12:30Z; rows=412; size=89KB

Nina (Billing): received. starting invoice mapping now. quick policy question: for historic invoices that have already been paid, do we issue refunds or credit the account? Finance to confirm.

Priya (Finance): policy: refunds only if requested by customer for payouts > $500; otherwise issue account credits and line-item adjustments for enterprise customers. document this in the remediation notes.

Alex (Support): noted. i'll prepare two message templates (refund request flow + credit notice) and post them here for legal review.

Raj (Eng): also proposing a short-term mitigation: add a dedupe window at ingestion and a metric for "duplicate-detection-rate". can we get an alert if duplicates exceed 0.2% of daily ingested events?

Priya (Finance): yes, please implement. also add an audit log flag so we can prove corrections later if customers ask.

Raj (Eng): will do. i'll push the canary patch to the staging cluster tonight and run a small replay to verify counts. ETA for canary deploy: 2026-03-15 22:00 UTC.

Nina (Billing): preliminary numbers after mapping: ~87 invoices impacted, 20 invoices > $1k. total estimated adjustment amount ~ $18,400. final numbers after cross-validate in 2h.

BillingBot: alert: remediation_tracker updated by @priya-finance at 2026-03-15T10:05:00Z; tracker_link=https://console.internal/redwood/remediation/2321112222

Priya (Finance): action summary:
- Raj (Eng): repro script, patch, staging canary, dedupe metric + PD alert (due 2026-03-15 EOD)
- Nina (Billing): invoice mapping, credit memos, batch corrections (start 2026-03-16)
- Alex (Support): customer templates + escalation matrix (draft 2026-03-16 12:00)

Priya (Finance): i'll own tracking and legal coordination. please update this thread when you complete your items.

Raj (Eng): updated: canary deployed to staging, initial replay shows dedupe prevented ~95% of duplicate attributions. pushing fix to canary cluster now.

Nina (Billing): mapping complete. posting owner+ETA table below in a follow-up doc.

Alex (Support): templates uploaded to google drive: https://drive.redwood/incident-2321112222/templates. will start outreach after billing confirms final customer list.

Priya (Finance): thanks all. i'll schedule a short wrap-up sync for Mon to confirm batches and postmortem action closure. :white_check_mark:
